name: Soil test at an accredited lab (Soil Health Card style: NPK, pH, EC, OC, micronutrients)
note: Test before you buy fertiliser: it decides how much is really needed.

name: KVK / agri-expert field visit voucher
note: A human expert confirms the problem before any chemical is used. Required when the kit stops at a chemical decision.

name: Yellow sticky traps (pack of 25)
note: Monitors and mass-traps whiteflies/aphids; no spraying.

name: Blue sticky traps (pack of 25)
note: For thrips monitoring.

name: Pheromone traps + lures for fruit borer / pink bollworm (set of 5)
note: Catches male moths; tells you when the pest is building up.

name: Neem oil based botanical (azadirachtin, 1 L)
note: Botanical repellent; follow the label. Not a cure for virus diseases.

name: Trichoderma viride bio-fungicide (1 kg)
note: Seed/soil treatment against soil-borne fungi; mix in compost as per label.

name: Pseudomonas fluorescens bio-agent (1 kg)
note: Seed treatment / soil application bio-agent.

name: Beauveria bassiana bio-insecticide (1 kg)
note: Fungus that infects insects; works best in humid weather.

name: Bio-fertiliser trio: Rhizobium/Azotobacter + PSB + KSB (3 x 1 L)
note: Cuts chemical fertiliser need; crop-specific strain matters.

name: Vermicompost (50 kg bag)
note: Organic matter for soil health.

name: Crop micronutrient mixture (Zn/B/Fe, 1 kg, as per state formulation)
note: Use only if deficiency is confirmed (soil test / symptoms checked by expert).

name: Zinc sulphate (5 kg)
note: Common zinc correction in rice-wheat systems; soil test first.

name: Certified tomato seed, ToLCV-tolerant hybrid (10 g)
note: Tolerant (not immune) to leaf curl virus; buy only certified/truthfully-labelled seed with a bill.

name: Certified chilli hybrid seed (10 g)
note: Certified seed with bill.

name: Certified pulse seed, local recommended variety (5 kg)
note: Use the state-recommended variety for your district.

name: Insect-proof nursery net, 40 mesh (10 m)
note: Keeps vectors off seedlings: the cheapest leaf-curl prevention.

name: Silver-black plastic mulch film (1 roll, ~400 m)
note: Saves water, suppresses weeds, reflective side repels some sucking pests.

name: Drip irrigation starter kit (0.25 acre)
note: Saves water; government drip subsidy may apply (PMKSY).

name: Plastic rain gauge
note: Simple record for irrigation decisions.

name: Knapsack sprayer, 16 L, with nozzles
note: Needed for any bio-input spray.

name: Spray safety kit: gloves, mask, goggles, apron
note: Mandatory with any spraying. Always added when a spray item is in the kit.

name: Plastic harvest crates (set of 5)
note: Cuts bruising losses vs. gunny bags.

name: Tarpaulin sheet 6x8 m (grain drying / rain cover)
note: Protects harvested produce from rain.

name: Hermetic grain storage bags (pack of 5)
note: Stops storage pests without chemicals.
